name: Roof Radar
tagline: Turns public storm reports into a ranked, evidenced roofing-lead list
description: For roofing contractors who prospect after weather events. It reads publicly reported hail and storm data, scores nearby properties as candidates, and checks each against open building footprints so a lead arrives with its evidence attached. Contacting homeowners is deliberately left to you.
author: SacredFolio
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
